speaker: Mikel Arteta
quote_text:
Hi everyone, if you have a question, raise  your hand and we'll come to you. You're  
ready? Gentleman in the front. Can I have your  thoughts on the tactics? Well, with we had so many  
expectations, obviously, to to believe that  we could turn it around, we needed generally  
momentum, especially in the first half, the game  started in in the first action almost. with them  
scoring and then the goal being denied. Then we  had the moment, two big moments, with Martin.  
We didn't capitalize the next action. They scored  the goal and obviously the game shifted. And then  
you need to stay cool, to score a goal as early as  possible. We didn't manage to do that in the first  
time, even though we had another big chance. And  in the second-half, then we started to struggle  
as the game went by. We didn't generate enough  situation, establish ourselves in the finals.  
Enough the game has started to get away from us.  Have you got one of your toughest opponents in  
English football now? Yeah, he's a tough opponent,  yeah. Tom, you mentioned that that chance they did  
feel like that had gone in and the score had  been two-one and the very different games,  
showing how fine margins are for Arsenal this  team. Yeah, but these are, you know, when you want  
to be in cup finals, you want to win trophies,  at the end, those are, they've been really  
affected in the box in the last two games that  we played against them and we haven't. Overall,  
that was the main difference. It's true that today  we've been a bit more unsettled, especially when  
the game became more chaotic or when they  were very direct with their play. Normally,  
we are much more composed. Today, we liked a bit  of that and the game went away from us. Can I just  
ask for an update on Gabriel Martin? Yeah, he felt  something. I think it was his hamstring and he was  
uncomfortable to continue, so we'll have to do an  MRI scan tomorrow to see external injury. Simon  
Standard. Mikael, I think that's 11 games in 36  days you've had now since the start of this year.  
Was tonight partly just the sort of exhaustion  from that period and how important is the break  
that you've got now? I wouldn't like, you know,  especially when we lose a game that is because  
physically we were tired. You know, we played  so many games, we played so many games every  
three days and we knew that that was going to be  a really high intensity one. I think emotionally  
as well it was a very different game that we  needed to get there, to believe right in the  
end that we could do it and before that unexpected  the game got away from us. Keith from Scott. How  
much does it feel like an opportunity missed  to get to the final over the two left? Well,  
yeah, if you're in a semi-final, you don't get  the final very much. Thank you. Two trophies  
left to play for now, how much is going out,  or you double your efforts in the recent desire  
to finish the season? Yeah, we need to swallow  this one. It's a tough one. We had a lot of  
expectations. We knew the difficulty of the task  because of the result that we brought from London.  
But there's nothing we can do right now. What we  could do is, it was on the pitch a few minutes  
ago. Now we have to look forward. First of all,  I think this is going to be a painful one. And  
while we are in Dubai, recharge and go again  because we have still a lot to play. Did you  
lose this in the first leg? Sorry? Well, we made  it really difficult, certainly for ourselves,  
yeah. James, Hi, Michael. Defensively, your team  today were quite uncharacteristically sloppy some  
moments and some mistakes that we don't usually  see from them. I mean, as a manager, what do you  
put that down to? I mean, the errors are part  of football and we've been super consistent.  
We've been really composed and today we give them  hope just by putting the ball along into our last  
line. And when we did that, we always looked  vulnerable because we allowed them to run from  
this situation and they are really the dangerous  team when they're able to do that. But certainly  
they don't want to do that. So what can I say?  Were you a bit surprised by how many Carson were  
set up with, you know, the five defenders, Fabio  pushing off? No. Finally, from the first slide,  
Alexander Essan, obviously the good performance  there at tonight, he again was on song. What kind  
of task was up for Salih, but Gabriel expects  up too harshly they did against Essan. Damn it.  
I know he has to evaluate opposition player, but  it's clear that he had two actions to finish and  
you know what happened. Okay, everyone.  Thanks very much. Thank you. Thank you.
title: Mikel Arteta post-match press conference | Newcastle United 2-0 Arsenal (Agg 4-0)
